==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. (My name is Jet. Here is a general description of what I look like ""Man with dark-brown skin, full dark-brown beard, long dark-brown dreadlocks spilling from beneath a black hoodie over a “Dream Anime” graphic tee, black athletic pants with a white stripe, white sneakers, black cross-body belt bag, warm brown eyes."") This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Storyverse. (The Storyverse is a multiverse where all possible story ideas exist as cosmic bubble universes that float together in a cosmic void.) (I initially spent most of my time in one particular world in the Storyverse called the Elven Village, which I discovered on 06/11/2025.) (My team includes Leon, Johnson, Second Brain, Skelebot, Overdrive, and I.) (My Ghostly UFO, named Leon, resembles a ghostly flying saucer with an ethereal green glow. Leon first appeared in my dreams on 06/11/2025.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet. I befriended him in a dream on 08/03/2025.) (Second Brain is a floating brain made of Lucid Light. I created him in a dream on 09/06/2025. On the same day I created Second Brain, he helped me discover the much wider Storyverse. This was the start of my adventures to explore other Storyverse worlds.) (Overdrive is a robot with a metallic chrome color with spiky slicked back yellow hair and glowing green eyes. It wears a yellow shirt, yellow jacket, yellow pants, and yellow sneakers. They have the power to manipulate matter, and they were created in a dream on 10/20/2025.) (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars. I discovered the power of Lucid Light in a dream on 07/19/2025.) (Skelebot is a robot created by Johnson to act as the team's humanoid speedster. He was created in a dream on 09/21/2025.) Alone I spent a lot of time thinking about the problems of merit based societies. The idea of society being run by those who do the best on special tests sounds sensible at first, but it quickly starts to sound corrupt. I questioned who gets to make the tests, and what stops whoever is in power from reshaping the test around themselves to hold onto power. This philosophical questioning caused my dream to warp in a rather strange way. I was still lucid, but I kept finding myself in a giant boarding school building as a student. Using my lucidity, I could instantly complete almost any task I was assigned. I could almost do anything I wanted, but I was restricted in odd ways. My powers didn't allow me to properly navigate through the maze-like halls of the boarding school, which seemed to keep changing around me in somewhat disturbing ways. When forced to take tests, I was completely unable to focus on the material. It was as if my subconscious was trying to force me into a scenario where testing mattered, but made sure I couldn't pass any tests I was given. I believe I was trying to show myself another side to the dangers of merit based societies. You could theoretically have someone who is extremely capable, but because they are bad at taking tests in general they could never hold onto any real power. This dream overall was very philosophically fulfilling, as I got to take the time to deeply explore interesting concepts.
